minimum_detectable_dose_rule: smallest nonzero dose with overall Holm p < 0.05 within the representation; all Stage 6K kinematic gates are already PASS
quality_association_positive_rule: task-adjusted log-cluster bootstrap 95% CI excludes zero

context_v2_go.rule: GO if learned64_full_context has positive fallback association with pair L2 or absolute kernel contribution in at least two of four doses; also report whether neighbor-zero reduces that positive-association count by at least two doses

rule_any: ego_kinematic_13d median overall Z_BDD is at least 1.5 times learned64_full_context and it passes at least two more task-dose Holm cells
handcrafted_interaction_trajectory_46d median overall Z_BDD is at least 1.25 times learned64_full_context and it passes at least three more task-dose Holm cells
learned64_neighbor_zero_input preserves at least 80% of learned64_full_context median overall Z_BDD, passes no fewer than one less task-dose Holm cell, and learned64_full_context meets context_v2_go

interpretation.go_meaning: prepare a separately versioned training protocol and data audit; do not overwrite the frozen checkpoint
